QUICK ANSWERS

Frequently asked questions.

Where do I start if I have a repair claim?

Check your agreement for the correct claims procedure and authorization requirements. You can also visit the official EDS Claims Portal for available resources.

How do I get roadside assistance?

Use the roadside telephone number and instructions printed in your agreement. Roadside services and limits vary by product.

Can I request a copy of my agreement?

Yes. Visit the official EDS Plan Holders page for the current contract request process. This demonstration does not transmit requests.

Can I transfer or cancel my agreement?

Transfer and cancellation eligibility and procedures depend on your agreement and applicable requirements. Consult the contract and official support resources.
